spans.s:
Bandhana denotes a ‘rope’ or other fastening in the
Atharvaveda^1 and later.^2
1) Av. iii. 6, 7 (of a boat, Nau);
vi. 14, 2.
2) Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa, xiii. 1, 6, 2
(of a horse); Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa,
iii. 8, 9, 4; Chāndogya Upaniṣad,
vi. 8, 2; Nirukta, xii. 38, etc.

Bandhu, denoting ‘relationship’^1 in the abstract and ‘rela-
tion’^2 in the concrete, occurs in the Rigveda and later.
1) Rv. v. 73, 4; vii. 72, 2; viii. 73,
12, etc.; Av. v. 11, 10, 11; Vājasaneyi
Saṃhitā, iv. 22; x. 6, etc.
2) Rv. i. 164, 33; vii. 67, 9; Av. x. 10,
23; Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa, iii. 7, 5, 5,
etc.; bandhumant, ‘having relations,’
Rv. viii. 21, 4; Taittirīya Saṃhitā, i. 5,
1, 4, etc.
